newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aoki Corp shares drop below 100 yen, record low.
newsitem.headline: Aoki Corp shares drop below 100 yen, record low.

text.p: Shares in Japanese construction firm Aoki Corp fell on Friday morning on continued sales ignited by worries about the company's financial health, brokers said.
As of 0014 GMT, the shares were down 10 yen to 90 yen, making the firm the top percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
It fell as low as 88 yen, surpassing its previous all-time low of 100 yen marked on Thursday. Turnover was 2.45 million, the second highest on the first section.
By 0027 GMT, Aoki shares had fallen even further to 70 yen.
"The construction sector is the Achilles' heel of the stock market," a "Big Four" broker said.
"General constructors including Aoki, and Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd which applied for court protection, are groaning under the weight of problem loans -- a legacy of the 'bubble era'," the broker said.
